card.name: Words just before a person or agent noun
card.fires_on: Fires on a word right before a likely agent noun, such as engine (crawlers), census (takers) or his (army). It also appears on linking words before a cell or actor noun.

modes.label: Modifier before agent noun
modes.description: A noun or modifier that is likely to be followed by a role noun like taker, crawler or worker.

modes.label: Possessive or link before actor
modes.description: A possessive or small linking word before a group of actors or cells.
modes.example: When Mao Zedong sent<< his>> army to integrate Tibet

modes.label: Partway through -ating words
modes.description: The middle of words like infiltrating or eating, just before the word cells.

card.writes: It pushes toward worker-type nouns such as worker, workers, soldier and nurse.
card.plain: It lights up on words that set up a coming noun for a person or group of actors, such as a worker or soldier.
